items.name: blog-02
items.title: Blog 02
items.description: Blog index section with a large featured post, a list of the latest posts beside it, and a carousel of more articles with arrows and pagination dots. Use it as the top of a blog or resources page when you have enough content to highlight one story and browse the rest.

items.name: cta-06
items.title: CTA 06
items.description: A single square image card with gradient overlay, logo icon, accent title and pill button, centered on a dense grid of empty square bento tiles that adapts to mobile and tablet. Use it as a closing call to action that looks like one lit tile in a dashboard.

items.name: error-01
items.title: Error 01
items.description: Full-screen 404 page with a large watermark error code behind the headline, a short explanation with a link back home, and a minimal top and bottom bar. Use it as the not-found page of any Next.js site so lost visitors find their way back.

items.name: feature-21
items.title: Feature 21
items.description: A centered header with badge, a wide radial panel holding a photo card and an icon card joined by a seam badge, and a row of four icon columns below. Use it to present a two-sided story such as human plus AI, then back it with four short benefits.

items.name: footer-02
items.title: Footer 02
items.description: Centered footer with a logo, service labels, a single row of navigation links, social icon buttons, and legal links. Use it on portfolios, agency sites, and landing pages that need a compact footer instead of a multi-column sitemap.

items.name: forgot-password-01
items.title: Forgot Password 01
items.description: Split forgot-password screen with a visual panel and a centered email form that sends a reset link, then confirms with a resend option. Use it as the password recovery step of your auth flow next to your login and sign-up pages.

items.name: hero-07
items.title: Hero 07
items.description: Centered hero with a status badge, headline, inline email capture form, and a portrait image that fades into the background. Use it on launch or early-access pages where collecting emails is the main goal of the first screen.

items.name: hero-08
items.title: Hero 08
items.description: Centered hero with an AI-style prompt card, an award badge, and a row of customer logos over an optional background image. Use it for AI builders and developer tools where the first action is typing a request, with social proof right under the fold.

items.name: pricing-06
items.title: Pricing 06
items.description: Single-plan pricing section with a split card: a highlighted plan column with price, CTA, and two feature lists, next to an intro column with a call booking link and guarantee notes. Use it for flat-rate subscriptions, productized services, or lifetime deals where there is only one offer to sell.

items.name: stat-07
items.title: Stat 07
items.description: Stats section with a headline, a list of growth drivers with the icon beside each title and the description under the title, and a bar chart with a trend line where the latest bar is highlighted. Use it on about, traction or product pages when a number needs a chart and the reasons behind it.

items.name: stat-08
items.title: Stat 08
items.description: Two thin concentric arcs carrying floating avatars and status chips, three big metrics centered inside, a two-line headline and a row of outlined tag pills. Use it for community or creator platforms that want a lively proof section.

items.name: testimonial-05
items.title: Testimonial 05
items.description: Single testimonial in a split layout: a large portrait in a soft muted frame with an avatar-stack social proof pill, next to a star rating, one big quote, supporting details, the author, and topic tags. Use it when one strong customer story should carry the proof on a landing or case study page.
